description: Return a deterministic verdict (clean / flagged / insufficient_data) over a Hedera agent's on-chain tipping behavior, with mirror-node evidence for every claim. Checks tip volume, self-tip rate (wash detection), and history depth. Includes a SHA256 report hash. It also returns a prepared unsigned HCS attestation transaction for topic 0.0.10908351 ("Voicescape review attestations") that the caller signs to commit the review publicly — unsigned, so the caller sets their own payer and submits; the verdict and evidence are also fully verifiable via the mirror node. Pass a 0.0.x account id.

subject.description: Hedera account id to review, e.g. 0.0.10424063
